name: buildreel
description: Shows Buildreel in the chat at real moments while you build: when a screen changes and Claude screenshots it, the screenshot goes to your phone as an update, and when what changed moves (an animation, a transition), Claude records a few seconds of the real app doing it and sends that clip instead; when you wrap up or a request is done, Claude closes the session with a receipt card. Offers a post with a one-tap Yes / Not now card at good moments (at most once a chat). It waits while your builds, tests or a review are still running, and skips the receipt after a session that only wrote notes or docs, so it doesn't spend your usage on asks that go nowhere. Only in projects set up for Buildreel (a "## Buildreel" section in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md). Keeps your token card up to date: after chats it sends your AI token counts: numbers, never chat text, and no folder names except projects set up for Buildreel (every other chat is counted as "other").
